premises.text: Web publishing is broken because non-developers cannot freely create or tweak pages without agencies
premises.evidence_span: There's a part of the internet that's fundamentally broken

premises.text: PageCloud turns the browser into an unrestricted visual editor where saves go live immediately
premises.evidence_span: When we hit Save to look at our changes, they are immediately live on the web. There's no other platform on the planet that gives you this creative freedom

premises.text: URL drag-and-drop embeds functional third-party widgets including e-commerce tickets
premises.evidence_span: go to Eventbrite and drag that URL right onto our page as well. And just like that, we've e-commerce enabled our site

premises.text: Mobile mode reflows desktop designs for phone layouts
premises.evidence_span: enter mobile mode. And in seconds, you can reflow your content to make sure it looks gorgeous on a mobile device

premises.text: Copy-page analyzes any web page into PageCloud-editable root content; Photoshop paste is supported
premises.evidence_span: PageCloud will analyze everything that's going on on this page, break it down into its root content and rebuild it in PageCloud editable format. It's pixel-for-pixel accurate

premises.text: Preorder pricing at $75/year with conference promo code
premises.evidence_span: using the Disrupt Promo Code, you're going to get an amazing price of just $75 for the year for your site

value.text: Create the web the way it was meant to be—without restriction
value.evidence_span: experience the web the way it was always meant to be

notes: HTML/CSS 1% statistic folded into the broken-publishing premise. Patents not split out.
